acceptedAnswer.text: SEO Bandwagon is the only extension in this comparison that measures Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS, FCP, TTFB) directly in the browser as you visit a page.

mainEntity.name: What is the best free SEOquake alternative?

acceptedAnswer.text: For on-page checks with scoring and Core Web Vitals, SEO Bandwagon is a free alternative that adds local SEO citation management. Detailed is a strong free option for a lightweight, single-click on-page overview.

mainEntity.name: What Chrome extension checks NAP consistency for local SEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: SEO Bandwagon detects when you are viewing a business directory listing, extracts the listing's name, address, and phone number, and scores it against your master business record — then lets you capture a proof screenshot and file the citation.
